    Irreducible hook and cohook maps in the finite module category #

    This file isolates the exact finite-string-sum input needed to turn the raw string-sum factorization theorems into categorical irreducibility. A finite-dimensional module is a finite string sum when its underlying raw functor is isomorphic to a finite biproduct of literal string modules. If every finite-dimensional module has this form, all four canonical hook and cohook maps are irreducible in the finite-dimensional module category.
